sections.title: When repair is needed
items: The air conditioner does not switch on or shows an error code.
The air stays warm after checking the mode and clean filters.
The outdoor unit does not start, makes unusual noise or switches off.
The indoor unit leaks, freezes or vibrates strongly.

sections.title: Diagnostics, repair and technical maintenance
items: Power supply, connections, temperature sensors and control board.
Indoor and outdoor unit fans.
Drainage, icing and causes of water leakage.
Cooling circuit and signs of refrigerant leakage; refrigerant is added only after checking the cause.

sections.title: Repair or cleaning
items: If dirty filters, the evaporator or drainage restrict operation, we recommend cleaning rather than repair.
If there is an error, leak, electrical fault, fan or outdoor-unit problem, cleaning alone is not enough.
The next step is chosen after diagnostics, without pre-selling unnecessary work.

diagnosisSteps.title: How air conditioner diagnostics works
diagnosisSteps.lead: We first separate dirt and incorrect settings from a technical fault.
items: Confirm the symptom, model, error code and when the problem started.
Check the operating mode, airflow, temperature and condition of both units.
Inspect electrics, sensors, fans, drainage and cooling circuit as indicated by the symptom.
Explain the cause, available repair and price before work begins.

trustSignals.title: Clear repair terms
trustSignals.lead: The customer knows the cause and price before approved work is carried out.
items: We do not present routine cleaning as a repair.
We do not add refrigerant without checking why it was lost.
We do not replace parts before agreeing the cost.
If an on-site repair is not possible, we explain the next step.

items.question: Why does the air conditioner run but not cool?
items.answer: Possible causes include dirt, an incorrect mode, icing, a fan or sensor fault, an outdoor-unit problem or a refrigerant leak. Diagnostics identifies the actual cause.

items.question: Does the air conditioner need refrigerant immediately?
items.answer: No. Refrigerant is not consumed like fuel. If the level is low, the system should first be checked for a leak.

items.question: When is cleaning enough instead of repair?
items.answer: Cleaning helps when dirty filters, evaporator, blower or drainage restrict airflow and cooling. Error codes, electrical and outdoor-unit faults need separate diagnostics.
